fields.label: Agent name
fields.description: What the owner calls this agent. Shown on the Agents page and as the chat title.

fields.label: Agent ID
fields.description: Runtime id, agent-u- followed by 10 lowercase hex characters. Set once on insert and never changed.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off: the agent is removed from the runtime, its chats and schedule stop.

fields.label: Allow shell and files
fields.description: On: the agent also gets a shell and file tools inside this workspace's sandbox. Off: no shell and no file writes.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional one-line summary, at most 1,000 characters.

fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: What the agent does, in the owner's words. At most 12,000 characters.

fields.label: Tools
fields.description: JSON list of the tool ids the owner picked (bare names such as get_list). Only these tools can run in this agent's chats.

fields.label: Can use a web browser
fields.description: On: the agent gets its own web browser. Needs Jarvis Settings > Enable a web browser for user agents. At most 3 agents per workspace.

fields.label: Browser can open
fields.options:
Listed sites only
Any public site
fields.description: Any public site: a web page can trick the agent into sending data it read to that site. Listed sites only reduces this.

fields.label: Sites
fields.description: One site per line, for example portal.gst.gov.in. Its subdomains are included. 1 to 30 sites.

fields.label: Sync status
fields.description: Synced: the runtime has this agent as saved. Pending: a change is on its way. Failed: the last change did not reach the runtime.

fields.label: Sync error code
fields.description: Machine code of the last failed sync, empty when the last sync worked.

fields.label: Sync error
fields.description: What went wrong with the last sync and what to do next.

fields.label: Synced at
fields.description: When the runtime last confirmed this agent. Empty until the first successful sync; chats need it.

fields.label: Day of week
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

fields.label: Day of month
fields.description: 1 to 31, clamped to the last day of short months.

fields.label: Time of day
fields.description: Local time the scheduled run starts (09:00 when empty).

fields.label: Scheduled prompt
fields.description: The message the agent receives on each scheduled run. At most 4,000 characters.
